generation.prompt:
Create one photorealistic vertical 9:16 educational photograph of Factory assembly line (工厂生产线). The result must look like a single candid real-world photograph, never a collage, cutaway diagram, catalogue layout or labelled illustration.

SCENE DIRECTION
Show a modern light-manufacturing assembly line from an aisle-level three-quarter viewpoint. Run one belt conveyor through the middle, ending beside a feeder bowl and a guarded work station. On the station, separate the pneumatic screwdriver, workpiece jig and inspection lamp; place the red emergency-stop button clearly on the machine frame and make the transparent guard edge visible. Put one component tote beneath the bench, a safety helmet on a hook and a parked pallet truck in the lower background. Include one operator observing from behind the guard with hands down. Use bright even industrial lighting and realistic brushed metal. No moving machinery blur, sparks, readable control text, massed identical products, exposed gears, missing guards, brand logos or duplicated targets.

REQUIRED LEARNING TARGETS
Show exactly one clear primary instance of each of these ten targets: industrial belt conveyor, parts feeder bowl, pneumatic assembly screwdriver, workpiece assembly jig, red emergency-stop button, transparent machine guard panel, quality-inspection task lamp, factory component tote, factory safety helmet, manual factory pallet truck.

COMPOSITION AND LEGIBILITY
Distribute the targets across the upper, middle and lower thirds and across both sides of the portrait frame. Preserve realistic scale, perspective, contact shadows and spatial relationships. Every target must have a distinct silhouette, be large enough to identify on a phone screen, and remain fully visible rather than hidden behind a person, furniture or another target. People may perform natural actions, but their hands and bodies must not cover the learning targets. Keep incidental background objects visually quiet.

STRICT EXCLUSIONS
No captions, vocabulary labels, subtitles, watermarks, brand logos, readable signage, licence-plate text or gibberish lettering. No duplicated target objects, floating objects, malformed hands, extra limbs, distorted tools, impossible reflections or physically incoherent architecture.
